notes.title: FWsim - Update 4.0.1.5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix: FWsim now always uses your high-performance graphics card (instead of onboard graphics)
[*] Several bugfixes
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Updated Italian, Spanish and French translations. You can contribute to FWsim translations by clicking the Help menu.
[*] FWsim now displays a correct waveform if you load 24-bit audio files.
[/list]

notes.title: FWsim Full Release - Available Now
notes.notes:
Dear Fireworks Fans,

we are excited to announce the full release of FWsim - Fireworks Display Simulator on Steam, today!

[previewyoutube=EBI_QuN8Rk4;full][/previewyoutube]


Since our launch on Early Access back in 2021, FWsim has improved a lot. To celebrate the full release, we are now making it even better with the addition of:

[list]
[*] Completely new graphics
[*] Load the entire world in 3D, thanks to data from Google Maps*
[*] Water, which you can add to any existing show, and combine with Google Maps data
[*] Multi Color Changes
[*] Mortar Sparks and Explosion Sparks
[*] Microstars
[*] Easier placement of fireworks on buildings
[/list]

*) Please note, we rely on external data for this feature. There is a risk this might stop working in the future - but we will do our best.

[b]A few words from the developers:[/b]

Lukas (Lead Developer): "I am very grateful to everyone who has been using FWsim over the years. I would especially like to thank our users who sent in lots of feedback over the past weeks. Keep creating great shows, you are awesome!"

Marcus (Head of Fireworks Design): "FWsim has been with me for many years and I am therefore very pleased about the development in recent years. We are proud to see such great shows from you every day and are very grateful for your feedback! We want to make FWsim the best fireworks simulator available. Look forwards to our next updates :)"


- The FWsim Team

notes.title: FWsim Full Release: Water, Real Environments, New Graphics, and more
notes.notes:
On November 3, we are leaving Early Access and officially launching on Steam. Check out the new trailer:


[previewyoutube=EBI_QuN8Rk4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]



[h1]List of new features in this release[/h1]

[list]
[*]Completely new graphics
[*]Load the entire world in 3D, thanks to data from Google Maps*
[*]Water, which you can add to any existing show, and combine with Google Maps data
[*]Multi Color Changes
[*]Microstars
[*]Easier placement of fireworks on buildings
[/list]

*) Please note, we rely on external data for this feature. There is a risk this might stop working in the future.

[h1]Want to try the new update right away?[/h1]

You can check out the new version right away, even before the official release, by switching FWsim to the beta branch in your Steam client:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347348/f3f2640650c79244c825d119274b274831008b97.png[/img]


Keep in mind we are still working on it, there's a few bugs we still need to fix. 

If you try it out, please leave your comments below.

notes.title: Lunar New Year Challenge: update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone:

We hope you're doing well! As many of you know, we started organizing a monthly event called FWsim Challenge after the release of the [i]FWsim: Fireworks Display Simulator[/i] Creative Edition. The first edition, focused on Chinese New Year, ended recently, so today we're sharing with you the result! Please congratulate Alberto Posulu, whose beautiful show took our heart from the very first seconds. Also, we invite you to watch the best moments of each submission in this video:

[previewyoutube=ScLVJbPQLx0;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you enjoyed it. Thanks for sharing your passion with us one more time. See you in a few days with new updates and April's FWsim Challenge!

notes.title: Update Notes for February 27, 2021
notes.notes:
This is version 3.2.0.10 and brings the following improverments:
[list]
[*] In video export, MP4 is now the default format.
[*] MP4 format details changed. It should now be compatible with most video editing software. (If the file doesn't work in your favorite video editor, please let us know)
[*] Effect selection filters more comfortable to use
[*] Bugfix: Crash when adding a new firing line at the same position as a previous one.
[/list]
